description: This file manages HTTP headers within a web server or HTTP handling library. It includes functions for creating, sanitizing, inserting, searching, appending, overwriting, removing, and tokenizing HTTP headers, as well as memory management routines.

methods.name: void _http_header_free(gpointer p)
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for an liHttpHeader, including its string data and the header structure itself.

methods.name: void _http_header_sanitize(liHttpHeader * h)
methods.description: Removes folding whitespace and converts line breaks in header data into a single space.

methods.name: liHttpHeader * _http_header_new(const gchar * key,size_t keylen,const gchar * val,size_t valuelen)
methods.description: Creates a new liHttpHeader with specified key and value, sanitizes it, and prepares it for insertion.

methods.name: liHttpHeaders * li_http_headers_new(void)
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new liHttpHeaders collection.

methods.name: void li_http_headers_reset(liHttpHeaders * headers)
methods.description: Clears all headers from the collection and frees associated memory.

methods.name: void li_http_headers_free(liHttpHeaders * headers)
methods.description: Frees the entire headers collection and all contained headers.

methods.name: void li_http_header_insert(liHttpHeaders * headers,const gchar * key,size_t keylen,const gchar * val,size_t valuelen)
methods.description: Inserts a new header into the collection, allowing duplicates.

methods.name: GList * li_http_header_find_first(liHttpHeaders * headers,const gchar * key,size_t keylen)
methods.description: Finds the first occurrence of a header with a given key.

methods.name: GList * li_http_header_find_next(GList * l,const gchar * key,size_t keylen)
methods.description: Finds the next occurrence of a header with a given key, starting from a provided list node.

methods.name: GList * li_http_header_find_last(liHttpHeaders * headers,const gchar * key,size_t keylen)
methods.description: Finds the last occurrence of a header with a specific key.

methods.name: void li_http_header_append(liHttpHeaders * headers,const gchar * key,size_t keylen,const gchar * val,size_t valuelen)
methods.description: Appends a value to the last header with the specified key or inserts a new header if none found.

methods.name: void li_http_header_overwrite(liHttpHeaders * headers,const gchar * key,size_t keylen,const gchar * val,size_t valuelen)
methods.description: Overwrites the last header with the specified key with a new value or inserts a new header if none found.

methods.name: void li_http_header_remove_link(liHttpHeaders * headers,GList * l)
methods.description: Removes a header from the collection and frees its memory.

methods.name: gboolean li_http_header_remove(liHttpHeaders * headers,const gchar * key,size_t keylen)
methods.description: Removes all headers with the specified key from the collection.

methods.name: liHttpHeader * li_http_header_lookup(liHttpHeaders * headers,const gchar * key,size_t keylen)
methods.description: Retrieves the last header with the specified key.

methods.name: gboolean li_http_header_is(liHttpHeaders * headers,const gchar * key,size_t keylen,const gchar * val,size_t valuelen)
methods.description: Checks if a header with the given key exists and matches a specified value.

methods.name: void li_http_header_get_all(GString * dest,liHttpHeaders * headers,const gchar * key,size_t keylen)
methods.description: Concatenates all headers with the specified key into a provided GString.

methods.name: void li_http_header_tokenizer_start(liHttpHeaderTokenizer * tokenizer,liHttpHeaders * headers,const gchar * key,size_t keylen)
methods.description: Initializes a tokenizer to parse values from headers with a specific key.

methods.name: gboolean li_http_header_tokenizer_next(liHttpHeaderTokenizer * tokenizer,GString * token)
methods.description: Retrieves the next token from the header's value, considering quoted strings and escape sequences.

methods.name: void _header_queue_free(gpointer data,gpointer userdata)
methods.description: unavailable
